caption: The drawing depicts an iron trivet with a decorative openwork design and a rectangular central plate bearing the inscription “NEW ENGLAND BUTT CO. BOSTON.” The trivet is shown in three views: a top view, a side profile view, and a three-quarter perspective. The top view details the symmetrical curling pattern within the trivet’s iron frame, and shows a looped handle at one end. The central plate with the inscription is bordered by a rope-like textured border, also seen in the perspective view. The trivet stands on three short feet as seen in the side and perspective views. There is a scale bar beneath the side profile, marked in inches. The entire drawing uses shades of black, gray, and white, suggesting the use of pencil or charcoal on an off-white or cream-colored background. The artist’s signature, “Felippa Towne,” appears in cursive in the bottom left corner. There are minor brownish stains at the very bottom of the paper.
title: Flat Iron Holder
